symptoms: Wound assessment for patients >= 6 years old: Clean, minor wound vs All other wounds (contaminated with dirt, faeces, saliva, soil, puncture wounds, avulsion, bites, burns etc).

management_steps.details: If primary tetanus series incomplete/unknown: Administer ATT 40IU IM STAT, 2nd dose 6 weeks later, 3rd dose 6 months later. If primary series completed: If most recent dose within past 10 years -> NO vaccine required. If most recent dose > 10 years ago -> Administer ATT 40IU IM.

If primary series incomplete/unknown: Administer ATT 40IU IM (2nd dose 6 weeks later, 3rd dose 6 months later) AND Administer Tetanus Immune Globulin (TIG) 250IU IM at separate sites (N.B. If > 24 hours since injury or heavy contamination, TIG 500IU IM). If primary series completed: If most recent dose within past 5 years -> NO vaccine required today. If most recent dose > 5 years ago -> Administer ATT 40IU IM.

warnings: Administer ATT and TIG at separate anatomical sites.
